name: studio-engine
description: AI-first documentary video engine: scene engine + Remotion composition.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @studio-engine/scene-engine && npm run build -w @studio-engine/editor-brain && npm run build -w @studio-engine/render
scripts.test: npm test -w @studio-engine/scene-engine && npm test -w @studio-engine/editor-brain && npm test -w @studio-engine/render && npm test -w @studio-engine/studio
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @studio-engine/scene-engine && npm run build && npm run typecheck -w @studio-engine/editor-brain && npm run typecheck -w @studio-engine/render && npm run typecheck -w @studio-engine/remotion && npm run typecheck -w @studio-engine/studio
